The '''Imperial Medal of Resolution''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who managed to "''uphold law at the [[Battle of Restuss]]''." It was slightly lower in rank than the [[Imperial Grand Medal of Resolution]], awarded to individuals who directly drove out [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Medal of Resolution appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. Because of the player-optional nature of the Battle of Restuss, it is unknown whether the medal was ever canonically issued.
